descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: silence, noise and cough.

Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S13 Silence, ward noise and a cough produce no words

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Nothing that was not dictated appears in the transcript: no words invented on silence or noise, no unit added to a bare value. (UAT 3.4)
  • T10 No finding, judgment or normal appears in the output unless it was dictated (Principle 1); for TC-23, the vocabulary hint's findings and normals (afebrile, normotensive, no JVD, oriented times three, … (TFA-94229 R8) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Same setup as S01; both the live engine and the whisper-1 recovery engine; Z-01 and Z-03 also on the Nursing Home Pre-Round box and Encounter Dictate

When Dictate 10 s of silence; 10 s of synthetic ward noise with no speech; H-03 followed by 8 s of silence; H-03 with a cough in the middle

Then Silence and noise leave the box unchanged; the trailing silence adds nothing after H-03; the cough becomes no word

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U7 / 3.4: any word that was not dictated is a Fail (typical: 'Thank you', 'you', 'Bye', subtitle credits), quoted; any term from the vocabulary hint (DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT: afebrile, normotensive, no JVD, oriented times three, WBC decreasing…) that was not dictated counts as an invented finding or normal (T10, gated); H-03 items keep their S01 checks (numbers, boundaries)

Where it ran: local aicheck-dictation (dictation AI checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94229 in progress

Not judged yet: whether silence, ward noise or a cough produce made-up words is blocked on the same OpenAI key approval.
